title: Mock week timed section: the open iftar
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Bringing the world together (5.1); revision begins; mock
source: Written for arabic/y11 lesson 31 (Mock papers prepared by the department; timed section (portal worksheet, our own text))
intro: Lesson 31. Timed section: 25 minutes. Read the rubric and the marks for each question before you start. Group A answers Section A (4AA1 style); Group B answers Section B (1AA0 Paper 3 style). Leave three minutes to check.

arabic.text: فِي رَمَضَانَ المَاضِي، نَظَّمَ مَسْجِدُ مَدِينَتِنَا إِفْطَارًا مَفْتُوحًا لِكُلِّ سُكَّانِ الحَيِّ. حَضَرَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ مِئَتَيْ شَخْصٍ مِنْ ثَقَافَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ. قَبْلَ المَغْرِبِ، شَرَحَ الإِمَامُ مَعْنَى الصِّيَامِ، وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَمَضَانَ شَهْرُ الصَّبْرِ وَالكَرَمِ. ثُمَّ أَكَلَ الجَمِيعُ التَّمْرَ وَشَرِبُوا المَاءَ مَعًا. كَانَ الطَّعَامُ لَذِيذًا، وَقَدْ طَبَخَتْهُ عَائِلَاتٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ. قَالَ أَحَدُ الجِيرَانِ: «كَانَتْ هٰذِهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ أَدْخُلُ فِيهَا مَسْجِدًا، وَشَعَرْتُ بِتَرْحِيبٍ كَبِيرٍ». وَفِي السَّنَةِ القَادِمَةِ، يُرِيدُ المَسْجِدُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ المَدَارِسَ القَرِيبَةَ أَيْضًا.

blocks.h: Section A (Group A): اِقْرَأِ النَّصَّ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ

questions.q: مَاذَا يُرِيدُ المَسْجِدُ فِي السَّنَةِ القَادِمَةِ؟

questions.a: مَفْعُولٌ بِهِ مَنْصُوبٌ وَعَلَامَةُ نَصْبِهِ الفَتْحَةُ
خَبَرُ كَانَ مَنْصُوبٌ وَعَلَامَةُ نَصْبِهِ الفَتْحَةُ

questions.q: لِمَاذَا جَاءَتْ «رَمَضَانَ» مَنْصُوبَةً فِي «إِنَّ رَمَضَانَ شَهْرُ الصَّبْرِ»؟

blocks.h: Section B (Group B): answer in English

questions.a: All the residents of the neighbourhood.

questions.q: What did the imam say Ramadan is? Give two details.
questions.a: The month of patience and generosity.

questions.q: What did everyone eat and drink together?
Why was the evening special for the neighbour?
questions.a: It was the first time they had been inside a mosque (and they felt very welcome).

questions.q: Translate into English: «كَانَ الطَّعَامُ لَذِيذًا، وَقَدْ طَبَخَتْهُ عَائِلَاتٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِنَ المَسْجِدِ.»
questions.a: The food was delicious, and many families from the mosque had cooked it.

markScheme.a: 12 marks. Comprehension: one mark each; accept a short phrase from the text. I'rab: one mark for the role, one for the sign of the case.

10 marks. Translation: 3 marks: one for each section (the food was delicious / and many families / from the mosque had cooked it), accepting 'cooked' or 'had cooked'. A TGA practice section, not a Pearson paper: check the style against the board's sample assessment materials before the mock.
